mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(t.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(t.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(t.document_version_id) AS documentVersionId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status, t.priority, RAWTOHEX(t.model_profile_id) AS modelProfileId, JSON_SERIALIZE(t.request_payload RETURNING CLOB) AS requestPayload, RAWTOHEX(t.requested_by) AS requestedBy, t.progress, t.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, t.error_code AS errorCode, t.retry_count AS retryCount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_ai_task (id, document_id, document_version_id, task_type, status, priority, model_profile_id, request_payload, requested_by, progress, idempotency_key, retry_count) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{task.id}), HEXTORAW(#{task.documentId}), HEXTORAW(#{task.documentVersionId}), #{task.taskType}, #{task.status}, #{task.priority}, HEXTORAW(#{task.modelProfileId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), CAST(#{task.requestPayload} AS JSON), HEXTORAW(#{task.requestedBy}), #{task.progress}, #{task.idempotencyKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.retryCount})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_ai_task t WHERE t.id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM edudoc_ai_task t WHERE t.document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex}) AND t.task_type = #{taskType} AND t.requested_by = HEXTORAW(#{requestedByHex}) AND t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY t.create_time ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET progress = #{progress} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', progress = 100, finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET status = 'CANCELED', finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET status = 'CANCELED', finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex})
UPDATE edudoc_ai_task SET idempotency_key = NULL WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{idHex}) AND idempotency_key LIKE 'ACTIVE:%'
